reason: MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen decision_rule: infrastructure failure prevents data collection on the distributed primary condition. The SameFileError fix from parent EXP-GRAPH-35544808911 is confirmed resolved (no copy-block crash). The C1 304-exclusion fix is present but has no effect (n304=0 on distributed). However, two NEW infrastructure bugs replace the original blockers: (1) DistributedManager RSA key sharing — each Flask node generates independent RSA key pairs at import via generate_rsa_keys(), so JWT tokens created on node A cannot be validated on node B. Round-robin routing sends get_token to node N then request to node N+1, causing ALL 1008 distributed samples to return 401 (behavioral_delta constant 7.0, std 0.0 on all 3 endpoints). This makes C1 TN=0.0, C2 0/3 endpoints with variance, C3-C5 NaN. (2) JSON serialization failure — numpy.bool_ and NaN values in metrics/controls crash json.dump at line 696 ('Object of type bool is not JSON serializable'), producing an empty result.json that masks raw evidence. The auditor recovered raw_evidence from raw_evidence/experiment_data.json and raw_evidence/metrics.json, confirming the RSA root cause. B-LOCAL-ONLY and B-CONCURRENT reconfirm orthogonality on single-node path (r=0.0233, CI upper < 0.091, TOST PASS). No scientific falsification of distributed orthogonality is implied — the testbed was unrunnable on distributed conditions.
